actual_source_repairs.title: Signed local cancellation models for the Khovanov Reidemeister moves
actual_source_repairs.statement: The integral signed Khovanov cubes have the local graded cancellation models described below. They are chain homotopy equivalences over every fixed exterior resolution, commute with exterior saddle differentials, and commute with multiplication by $X$ at every marked point outside the local disk. Consequently they also give chain homotopy equivalences after taking the reduced quotient. For the crossing with A-smoothing the identity matching and B-smoothing the cap-cup matching, the two three-crossing braid cubes with words $121$ and $212$ retract to the same three-term complex. The two-crossing inverse-pair cube retracts to the identity matching in local cohomological degree one and quantum shift upward by one. All retractions are integral; their homotopies and the two cancellations in the three-crossing cube are specified in the proof.

actual_source_repairs.title: Cut tangles of marked knots have relative Reidemeister movies
actual_source_repairs.statement: Assume countable choice. Let $(D,p)$ and $(D',p')$ be finite regular diagrams of the same oriented smooth knot, with marks away from crossings. Remove a small open arc about each mark and regard each complementary diagram as a one-interval tangle diagram in a disk, using the complementary disk in the projection sphere. Identify their two boundary endpoints and short oriented product collars. The resulting proper arcs can be realized in one standard smooth three-ball so that they are smoothly isotopic with those endpoints and collars fixed. Their diagrams are connected by a finite sequence of planar isotopies and oriented Reidemeister moves supported away from those collars. This holds when the two diagrams coincide and only the mark has moved along the knot.

actual_source_repairs.title: Khovanov complexes are chain homotopy equivalent under Reidemeister moves
actual_source_repairs.statement: Let $D,D'$ be finite regular oriented link diagrams related by a planar isotopy or one oriented Reidemeister move. Let $\bar C(D)$ be the integral signed state cube before the writhe shifts, with cohomological degree $|v|$ and quantum degree $|v|+\sum\deg(a)$, and normalize it by $C(D)=\bar C(D)[n_-]\{2n_--n_+\}$ to obtain the state degrees $i=|v|-n_-$ and $j=|v|+n_+-2n_-+\sum\deg(a)$. Before normalization, a positive type-I curl gives $\bar C(D_+)\simeq\bar C(D)\{1\}$, a negative type-I curl gives $\bar C(D_-)\simeq\bar C(D)[-1]\{-2\}$, a type-II move gives $\bar C(D_{II})\simeq\bar C(D)[-1]\{-1\}$, and a type-III move gives an unshifted equivalence. Consequently the normalized complexes are bigraded chain homotopy equivalent. If $D,D'$ are based knot diagrams and the move disk is disjoint from the basepoint, the same chain homotopy equivalence descends to their reduced quotient complexes, equivalently to the cut-tangle complexes with interval module $M=\mathbb Z$, $X\cdot1=0$.

actual_source_repairs.title: Khovanov homology is an oriented link invariant
actual_source_repairs.statement: Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. For every nonempty oriented link $L$, the bigraded integral groups $Kh^{i,j}(L):=H^i(C^{*,j}(D))$, where $D$ is any finite regular oriented diagram of $L$ and $C(D)$ is the normalized Khovanov cochain complex, are independent of the choice of $D$ up to bigraded isomorphism.

actual_source_repairs.title: Reduced Khovanov cohomology is invariant under based moves and basepoint transport
actual_source_repairs.statement: Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Let $K$ be an oriented knot and let $(D,p)$ and $(D',p')$ be finite regular oriented diagrams of $K$ with basepoints away from all crossings. Then the reduced integral groups $\widetilde{Kh}^{i,\widetilde j}(D,p)$ and $\widetilde{Kh}^{i,\widetilde j}(D',p')$ are isomorphic for every $(i,\widetilde j)$. In particular, they are invariant under Reidemeister moves supported away from the basepoint and under transport of the basepoint along the knot.

actual_source_repairs.title: Khovanov Euler characteristics equal the Jones polynomial
actual_source_repairs.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $V_L(t)$ be the library Jones polynomial of a nonempty oriented link $L$, normalized by $V_{\bigcirc}(t)=1$. For every diagram $D$ of $L$, put $q=-A^{-2}$ and $t=q^2=A^{-4}$. Then the integral rank Euler characteristics satisfy
$$\sum_{i,j}(-1)^i\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb Z}Kh^{i,j}(L)q^j=(q+q^{-1})V_L(t).$$
If $L=K$ is a knot with any basepoint $p$ away from the crossings, then
$$\sum_{i,\widetilde j}(-1)^i\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb Z}\widetilde{Kh}^{i,\widetilde j}(K,p)q^{\widetilde j}=V_K(t).$$
The unreduced factor $q+q^{-1}$ and reduced factor $1$ are the respective unknot normalizations.
